# Route snapshots

saigon.json contains six actual OSRM driving responses captured on 05 October 2026, one request at a time with more than one second between requests. Pickup: 10.77670,106.70330 (Nhà hát Thành phố). Keys are exact pickup|destination latitude,longitude pairs rounded to five decimal places.

These are saved road routes from https://router.project-osrm.org, based on OpenStreetMap data. They are not fabricated paths, traffic measurements or Uber fare quotes. They are used only after a live route request fails and are labeled in the UI. No arbitrary coordinates are assigned a synthetic route.

Routing engine: OSRM — https://project-osrm.org/
Data: © OpenStreetMap contributors — https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
Service usage: https://routing.openstreetmap.de/about.html
